audit.why: Nautilus's Dredge Line (Q) is his only real engage at 14/13/12/11/10s CD, and Depth Charge (R, 120/100/80s CD) is unstoppable — both are concrete numbers worth stating for step-up timing.

audit.why: Dredge Line hook, the passive root-on-hit, and Titan's Wrath shield let Nautilus out-brawl Braum through levels 1-5 and even into his first item; Depth Charge (R) is unstoppable so Braum's Fissure can't cancel it at 6. Only once Braum has tank items does projectile-blocking Unbreakable neutralize the hook and let peel value take over, matching win[6]='Braum'.
